about_the_game:
This is a sweet physics-based balance game made for lovers of gothic charm.

Over 100 unique macaron designs await you.
From base colors and flavors to delicate toppings and decorations, gently stack your own custom macarons—one by one.

Take your time. Place each macaron softly and carefully, without upsetting the balance.
And when your tower stands tall, beautifully arranged by your own hand—
A single rose on the far right will begin to glow quietly, as if by magic.

It feels almost like your heart is being gently restored.

✦ How to Play ✦
・Stack: Choose your favorite macarons and place them carefully
・Balance: The less it tilts, the better your score — and a little bonus, too!
・Decorate: Stack well and you might earn ribbons or cookies as decorations
・Collect: Mix and match bases and toppings to complete your macaron collection
・Customize: Change the pedestal and background to match your favorite aesthetic

With soft sounds and delicate visuals, everything in this game is quiet and sweet.
Even on hard days—when you feel low, or just can’t do anything else—this game is something you can do.

If it can become something that quietly stays by your side…
That would make us very happy.

Streaming & Video Content Guidelines

Both individuals and organizations are welcome to monetize content featuring this title, as long as it follows our guidelines.

name: Macaron Sickness
short_description: Welcome to a dreamlike world where gothic elegance meets sweet delights. This macaron tower balance game is made for lovers of all things gothic. When you're feeling down or need a little sweetness, build your own fragile and beautiful macaron tower—just for you.
